title: JLR 306DT external PID/DID candidates (pre-first-contact research)
engine_family: 306DT / AJ-V6D Lion 3.0 V6 diesel (X260 XF, EU6 SCR)

confidence.22042c_soot: medium - two independent JLR-diesel provenances (XF 2.2d forum capture, Car Scanner's own JLR PID via ELM327-emulator log on an L322 4.4 TDV8); NOT yet read on the 3.0 V6; units label g/m^3 reads more like a percent soot load
confidence.mode01_aftertreatment: standard-defined formulas (SAE J1979DA via DashLogic) - legislated, not JLR-invented; per-car support on this ECU unknown until asked
confidence.dead_on_2_2d: 220417 / 220434 / 220598 / 22D922 all returned zero on the XF 2.2d - Ford Duratorq family, unlikely on the Lion V6; listed so nobody re-chases them blind
confidence.l494_sweep_2026_08_18: On-car sweep, VIN SALWA2EK8HA (HY32-14C204-PAE): 191 DIDs live (136 in 0300-05FF, 55 in F400-F4FF). 2100-21FF and 2200-22FF are fully unimplemented (all 256 refused NRC 31 in each range) - never sweep them again on this family. 042C refused NRC 31 (dead on this calibration). 0417/0434/0598 all ANSWERED - they are NOT dead, the earlier 'dead on 2.2d' rows were wrong for this car - and F40C/0430/F423/F463/F485 answered raw at idle as aftertreatment-shaped candidates.
confidence.sdd_169_cross_check: SDD 169 dealer data decrypted and cross-checked (see data/sdd_dids.json). SDD confirms 042C is a real diesel-PCM DID (DPF soot g/l, differential-pressure inferred) though this PCM refuses it, and it decodes several live DIDs by name/scaling: 0396 service distance (km), F405 coolant (deg C, byte-40), 0479 stop-start counter, 0463 injector correction codes (64 bytes), and urea/SCR DIDs 05FA-05FD. SDD read frame for 042C is 22 04 2C. SDD names none of F40C/0430/0434/F423/F463/F485/0417/0598, so those stay sweep-candidates.

sources: https://torque-bhp.com/community/main-forum/dpf-active-regeneration/ (22042C on a 2014 XF Sportbrake 2.2d, raw response 7E80562042C3CE6)
https://www.fullfatrr.com/forum/post671897.html (Car Scanner's JLR soot PID = 22042C, captured via Ircama ELM327-emulator on an L322 4.4 TDV8)

https://www.jaguarforums.com/forum/general-tech-help-7/custom-pids-torque-app-oil-temp-oil-level-trans-temp-more-213503/ (OJG pack v1.1 PDF: adds 22D120 diff-lock state, diesel 'expected compatible' claim)
https://www.dropbox.com/s/kmdtvb80g53ybe8/x351_x150_pids.csv?dl=0 (OJG metric CSV, retrieved verbatim - matches the shipped JLR_DIDS table)

https://www.discosportforums.co.uk/threads/obdii-parameter-ids-pids-to-detect-dpf-regeneration.14064/ (Car Scanner standard-sensor approach; the circulating 'PID 244' is a ChatGPT hallucination - disregard)

dids.name: DPF soot concentration (SDD: inferred from differential pressure)
dids.provenance: SDD 169 MDX_PCM_D (0x042C, res 0.00152590219 g/l), corroborated by the XF 2.2d forum capture and Car Scanner's JLR PID - but REFUSED (NRC 31) on the L494 306DT PCM 2026-08-18
dids.notes: Real diesel-PCM DID per SDD 169 (DPF soot g/l, res 0.00152590219, from differential pressure) and proven absent on this 3.0 V6 (L494, HY32-14C204-PAE): it answers 7F 22 31. Read frame is 22 04 2C - the 22 F0 4C 2C that circulated in the earlier notes was fabricated. Formula nulled so nothing polls a dead DID; SDD scaling kept here and the full definition is in data/sdd_dids.json, so the row can be read without being re-chased.
